name: Echo II
source:
The story picks up in 2021, six years after the events of Echo 1. Chase, along with his new boyfriend Michael (Leo’s older brother) and TIMMY, an old friend with ties to Antifa, find themselves drawn into the ongoing unraveling of Echo 2. This visual novel is the downfall of Echo and Leo, as Chase must navigate the turmoil and attempt to save Leo from his toxic beliefs and political misinformation. He didn't take the vaccine...The narrative is set against the backdrop of the January 6th insurrection, with themes of election fraud conspiracies and media manipulation (fox news). Also Project 2025. There will be rachel maddow and kalama harris in here!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006125855/https://antaproject.itch.io/echo-ii]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在2021年，也就是《Echo 1》事件的6年後。Chase與新男友Michael（Leo的哥哥）以及和Antifa有關聯的老朋友TIMMY，一同捲入《Echo 2》持續發酵的事件中。這部視覺小說講述Echo和Leo逐漸走向崩潰的過程。Chase必須在混亂中尋找出路，並試著將Leo從有害的信念和錯誤的政治資訊中拯救出來。他沒有接種疫苗……故事以1月6日的暴亂為背景，涉及選舉舞弊陰謀論和媒體操縱（Fox News），也會談到「2025計畫」。Rachel Maddow和賀錦麗也會登場！

[來源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006125855/https://antaproject.itch.io/echo-ii]Itch.io[/url]]
